title: Additive Hom coordinates for the free triangle
statement: With [lem-sf-cyclic-free-resolution-coordinates] and [def-sf-cyclic-derived-hom-data], the specified free adjunction gives additive equivalences Hom(IUM,N) ≃ V^0 and Hom((IUM)[1],N) ≃ V^-1. The first sends precomposition with the counit to cyclicDerivedForget. The second intertwines native precomposition and postcomposition with underlying precomposition and shifted postcomposition. The cyclic action on V^r is bijective for every r.

source.place: Tags 0149, 0152 and 015F; parent calculus steps 1--2 and normalized free-resolution steps 5--9.

proof.text: Compose the additive Hom equivalence of the localized free adjunction with the canonical zero-shift identification. For degree minus one first move the source shift to the target by the shift equivalence, then apply the free adjunction and its exact-forgetting shift comparison. The counit formula and naturality follow from the adjunction identities and naturality of that comparison.
The cyclic action is the map on Hom of the equivalence D(F), conjugated by structure and shift isomorphisms, hence bijective.

proof_origin.place: Explicit proof of parent calculus steps 1--2 using the existing normalized cyclic resolution, Stacks 0149, 0152, 015F.

theorem cyclicDerivedFreeShiftedHomEquiv_naturality
    (M N M' N' : DerivedCategory (IsoAlgebra F)) (a : M' ⟶ M) (c : N ⟶ N')
    (f : (((cyclicDerivedFreeFunctor F).obj M)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ⟶ N) :
    cyclicDerivedFreeShiftedHomEquiv F M' N'
        (((cyclicDerivedFreeFunctor F).map a)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫ f ≫ c) =
      (forget F).mapDerivedCategory.map a ≫ cyclicDerivedFreeShiftedHomEquiv F M N f ≫
        ((forget F).mapDerivedCategory.map c)⟦(-1 : ℤ)⟧'
